column1: # Class renames from Minecraft 1.20.1 (Mojang names) straight to 26.3, for classes Fabric intermediary did not
# carry across versions (so the 1.21.11 step cannot find them). One rename per line: old<TAB>new<TAB>evidence

column3: 26.x: ParticleResources.SpriteParticleRegistration.create returns a 26.x ParticleProvider (createParticle gained a RandomSource); old registrations return old providers, adapted by the era
26.3 ParticleProvider.createParticle(options, level, x, y, z, xAux, yAux, zAux, RandomSource): the RandomSource was added; 1.20.1 providers implement the 8-argument form
26.3 ParticleRenderType is a record of particle groups (SINGLE_QUADS, ...); textured particles pick a SingleQuadParticle.Layer; 1.20.1's PARTICLE_SHEET_* passes are gone
1.21.2 removed DirectionProperty (it was EnumProperty<Direction>); 26.3 BlockStateProperties.FACING/HORIZONTAL_FACING are EnumProperty<Direction>, so fields and descriptors keep working
26.3 RecipeSerializer is a final record (MapCodec, StreamCodec); 1.20.1 mods implement the old JSON/buffer interface, kept as LegacyRecipeSerializer

1.21.2 rebuilt the recipe book around server-side recipe displays (RecipeBookComponent<T>, no GhostRecipe); 1.20.1 mods' recipe books become an always-hidden LegacyRecipeBookComponent so their screens keep working

1.21.2: client recipe book tabs (the RecipeBookCategories enum Forge extended) became registry RecipeBookCategory objects chosen by the server; intermediary pairs the old enum with 26.3's RecipeBookCategories holder class, which has no instances

1.21.9: block entity renderers extract a render state and submit nodes (BlockEntityRenderer<T, S>); 1.20.1 renderers drew immediately into a MultiBufferSource and run through LegacyBlockEntityRendererAdapter
1.21.9: BlockEntityRendererProvider<T, S> creates render-state renderers; 1.20.1 providers create old renderers (same Context)

1.21.4: item models are item model definitions resolved into ItemStackRenderState; old renderers only query a model (isGui3d), answered from the render state. (Not 26.3 BlockStateModel: that is for block states.)

1.21: enchantments became data-driven; 26.3 Enchantment is a final record (description, definition, exclusiveSet, effects) loaded per server. 1.20.1 mods subclass Enchantment(Rarity, EnchantmentCategory, EquipmentSlot[]) and pass Enchantments.X around; LegacyEnchantment is that API, for mod enchantments and as views of vanilla ones

26.x game rules rewrite: GameRules.Key<T> became GameRule<T> (26.3 GameRules.get(GameRule<T>), rules such as NATURAL_HEALTH_REGENERATION are GameRule<Boolean>); the name layer already maps RULE_NATURAL_REGENERATION to NATURAL_HEALTH_REGENERATION

26.x: the configured feature became the Feature interface (26.3 Feature.place(WorldGenLevel, ChunkGenerator, RandomSource, BlockPos), registry worldgen/feature; packfix moves data configured_feature/ to feature/); 1.20.1 Feature is rebased to the era LegacyFeature

1.20.2: BlockSourceImpl merged into the BlockSource record (26.3 DispenserBlock.dispenseFrom creates new BlockSource(level, pos, state, blockEntity) where 1.20.1 created new BlockSourceImpl(level, pos))

26.x: item model properties became RangeSelectItemModelProperty (get(stack, level, ItemOwner, seed) + a codec type), not the same interface (intermediary pairs them); the era keeps 1.20.1 ItemPropertyFunction (call(stack, level, LivingEntity, seed)) for mod lambdas
1.20.3: Component.Serializer (Gson adapter) replaced by ComponentSerialization.CODEC; the era class keeps toJson/fromJson over that codec

1.21.2: EffectRenderingInventoryScreen became the EffectsInInventory helper that container screens own (26.3 AbstractContainerScreen draws effects); a mod screen extending it is a container screen (same (menu, inventory, title) constructor)
net.minecraft.util.Tuple is in the 1.20.1 sources and in neither 1.21.11 nor 26.3; Curios 5.14.1 has it in its API (DropRulesEvent, ICuriosItemHandler), so the era keeps the class

1.20.2 changelog: ImageButton takes WidgetSprites; 1.20.1 mods subclass it with the texture constructors (xTexStart, yTexStart, yDiffTex, texture) and override renderWidget (Curios 5.14.1 CuriosButton, RenderButton, CosmeticButton)

1.21.4: ModelResourceLocation removed, models are named by Identifier (26.3 ModelLocationUtils: ns:item/path); 1.20.1 ModelResourceLocation extended ResourceLocation, and mods pass it where one is expected (Corn Delight 1.2.11 ModelEvent.RegisterAdditional.register)

1.20.2: AbstractSelectionList became an AbstractWidget (x/y/width/height instead of x0/y0/x1/y1, no itemHeight-based geometry getters), and 26.x changed its scrolling and entry drawing; 1.20.1 mods subclass the old list and call its members (Nature's Compass 1.12.0 BiomeSearchList, SpectreLib 0.13.15 config lists)
1.20.1 AbstractSelectionList.Entry.render(graphics, index, top, left, width, height, ...); see AbstractSelectionList
1.20.1 ObjectSelectionList extends the old AbstractSelectionList; see AbstractSelectionList
1.20.1 ObjectSelectionList.Entry; see AbstractSelectionList
1.20.1 ContainerObjectSelectionList extends the old AbstractSelectionList; see AbstractSelectionList
1.20.1 ContainerObjectSelectionList.Entry; see AbstractSelectionList
